title: Cyclic carbon process

intent.message: Carbon cycles among atmosphere, ocean, biosphere, and lithosphere through named fluxes.

claims.statement: Carbon cycles among four reservoirs rather than moving in one direction.
Photosynthesis and respiration form the atmosphere-biosphere exchange.

expected_design_characteristics: A clockwise cycle with a discoverable entry point and consistent direction
Reservoirs emphasized by visual weight and hierarchy, never by size-coded magnitude
Flux labels attached to their connectors instead of floating freely
No crossing flux paths; each reservoir keeps a stable position
known_failure_modes: The cycle rendered as an unordered cluster of boxes
Inconsistent arrow directions around the loop
Flux labels colliding with reservoir boxes or each other
